results.title: Earnings call transcript: News Corp Q3 2026 beats expectations with strong growth - Investing.com
results.content: # Earnings call transcript: News Corp Q3 2026 beats expectations with strong growth By Investing.com. # Earnings call transcript: News Corp Q3 2026 beats expectations with strong growth. Image 1: Earnings call transcript: News Corp Q3 2026 beats expectations with strong growth. News Corp reported robust earnings for the third quarter of fiscal year 2026, exceeding expectations with an EPS of $0.21, compared to the forecasted $0.19, marking a 10.53% surprise. The company’s stock showed a slight increase of 0.07% in aftermarket trading, reflecting a stable investor response to the positive financial results. News Corp continued its trend of strong performance with its 12th consecutive quarter of year-over-year growth in total segment EBITDA. The company reported a 9% increase in total revenue and an 18% rise in total segment EBITDA, driven by operational efficiency and strategic diversification. Despite challenges in the news media segment, the company remains on track for another record fiscal year of profitability.

results.content: SAN DIEGO , May 7, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Sempra (NYSE: SRE) today reported first-quarter 2026 earnings, prepared in accordance with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP), of $1.04 billion or $1.58 per diluted share, compared to first-quarter 2025 GAAP earnings of $906 million or $1.39 per diluted share. results.content: ScanXNewsMonarch Surveyors and Engineering Consultants Limited Schedules H2 FY26 Earnings Conference Call for May 11, 2026. # Monarch Surveyors and Engineering Consultants Limited Schedules H2 FY26 Earnings Conference Call for May 11, 2026. Monarch Surveyors and Engineering Consultants Limited has notified BSE Limited of its H2 & FY26 Earnings Conference Call, scheduled for Monday, May 11, 2026 at 04:00 PM IST. Senior management including the Managing Director, Whole Time Directors, CFO, and COO are expected to participate. Dial-in access is available for participants across India and international locations including Hong Kong, Singapore, the UK, and the USA. Consultants  has announced the scheduling of its Earnings Conference Call to discuss operational and financial performance for H2 and FY26. The intimation was filed with BSE Limited on May 06, 2026, pursuant to Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. The Earnings Conference Call is scheduled for **Monday, May 11, 2026 at 04:00 PM IST**.
